sn36.6:1.25: The ablative _dukkhasmā_ here is inexplicable and must be a mistake. Normally it occurs with _parimutto_, where the normal sense “from” applies, as it does with _visaññutto_ below. Probably the form here was normalized by analogy. Read _saññutto dukkhan’ti_.
sn36.6:4.1: Text seems to require an implicit “mental” (supplied by BB and Ṭhānissaro) or an idiomatic sense of vedayati as “affected” (Woodward). I follow the latter.
